name: HEC Need Based Scholarship (NBS)
eligible_universities: HEC-selected public-sector universities/DAIs only (participating list not published on pages read); NOT for self-finance admissions
academic_eligibility: Must secure admission on merit as per the institution's policy; already-enrolled students in financial need may also apply
financial_eligibility: Financial need assessed by the university's Institutional Scholarship Award Committee (family financial background); no fixed income ceiling stated
documents_required: HEC NBS application form (Downloads page) + supporting documents, submitted to the university Financial Aid Office only (HEC accepts no direct applications)
award_coverage: University tuition fee + stipend Rs 6,000/month for the complete programme (Eligibility page); paid via the university
deadline: Set by each participating university's Financial Aid Office (no national date published)
renewal_notes: Funding continues for complete duration of programme; dropouts replaced from current-year waiting list
notes: Programme pages live on HEC site 2026-10-10 but no current call/window dated -> status unknown. Karachi public universities on HEC list (NED, UoK, IBA, DUET, SMIU, etc.) are candidates but participation per year is NOT confirmed.

name: BISP Scholarships for Undergraduates (formerly Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship)
eligible_universities: HEC-recognised public-sector universities (list PDF: Ehsaas-Uni-List.pdf); excludes affiliated colleges and distance learning
academic_eligibility: Admission secured on merit; HEC-allowed degree programmes; age limit per institution. Eligibility page still references 'newly admitted students of Fall 2021'
financial_eligibility: Need criteria per project policy (details on HEC page); ineligible if availing another scholarship, or admitted on self-finance/self-support/evening higher-fee seats
documents_required: Applicant CNIC/B-Form; parents' CNIC; salary slip/income certificate (or Rs 50 stamp-paper undertaking for daily wage/shopkeeper/private job); last 6 months utility bills; rent agreement if rented; siblings' fee receipts; medical bills if any; photo; photo of house front. Hard copy to university SFAO
award_coverage: Semester tuition fee as per actual + Rs 40,000 per annum
notes: HEC How-to-Apply page states 'The scholarship portal is currently closed' (2026-10-10). Renamed to BISP on HEC site. Do not show as open.

name: Sindh Educational Endowment Fund (SEEF) Trust Scholarship 2025-26
provider: SEEF Trust, College Education Dept, Government of Sindh
eligible_levels: undergraduate and postgraduate (disciplines per 2025-26 ad: all Engineering, BS Social Science, Business Administration, LLB 5-yr, Information Technology; Bahria notice adds medical/DPT/Pharm-D/Nursing/Agri/DVM)
eligible_locations: Sindh domicile AND permanent resident of Sindh
eligible_universities: Institutions on SEEF Trust panel (90 entries; see /workspace/futurepath-data/clean/seef_panel_universities.csv); students of affiliated colleges not eligible
academic_eligibility: Minimum CGPA 2.5 or 60%; first-year students must provide admission letter; dropped-out/pass-out students not eligible
financial_eligibility: 2025-26 ad income groups (annual family income): A Rs 100,000-1,500,000 (80% share); B Rs 1.5-2.5M (10%); C Rs 2.5-6M (10%). SEEF About-Us page (older wording): parents' annual net income not more than Rs 1.5 million. Seat quota: 86% poor/needy/meritorious, 2% special needs, 2% minorities (per ad)
documents_required: Online form (form-seef.com) + printed copy; income certificate certified by Assistant Commissioner Revenue / FBR; service certificate (+ latest payslip) if parent is government employee; admission letter (first-year); domicile; submit to university Financial Aid office
award_coverage: Tuition fee for ONE academic year (2025-26) paid to the university against invoice (About-Us: 100% tuition fee)
renewal_notes: Covers one year only; students must re-apply in the next annual call
notes: Deadline 31-Aug-2026 passed -> closed. Next cycle (2026-27) not announced as of 2026-10-10. Income groups taken from IIUI-hosted copy of the official SEEF ad (scanned PDF).

name: Prime Minister's National ICT Scholarship Program (PMNICTSP)
provider: Ignite - National Technology Fund (formerly National ICT R&D Fund), MoITT
eligible_locations: Historically: rural/non-metropolitan/marginalised areas incl. AJK, FATA, GB
award_coverage: Historically fully funded 4-year ICT degree
notes: Included so the matcher/counselor never presents it as open: FAST still lists 'ICT Scholarships' as an external sponsorship, but Ignite's 2024-28 business plan says the programme ran 2007-2014. Source seen via WebSearch extract of the official Ignite PDF (not downloaded).

name: Ihsan Trust Interest-Free Education Loan (Qarz-e-Hasna)
eligible_levels: university students (level not specified on homepage)
eligible_universities: Educational partners incl. AKU, Bahria, DSU, FAST-NU (all campuses), Habib, IBA Karachi, Iqra, IoBM, JUW, KMDC, Karachi Metropolitan Univ, KSBL, NED, Salim Habib, SSUET, SZABIST (all), UoK, UIT, LUMS, Sukkur IBA (partner page)
financial_eligibility: Needy and deserving students (criteria not stated on pages read)
award_coverage: Interest-free educational loan (repayable) - NOT a grant
deadline: Via partner university financial-aid office; no public deadline
notes: Also referenced by FAST (external sponsorship) and Hamdard (Qarz-e-Hasna MoU). Mark as loan in UI.

name: IBA Karachi Need-Based Financial Assistance (scholarship / Bridge Financing / Qarz-e-Hasna / instalments)
eligible_levels: undergraduate and graduate (full-time morning programmes only)
academic_eligibility: Only after securing admission; maintain CGPA >= 2.5 (probation below); course-basis up to 8 consecutive semesters; repeated/withdrawn/remedial courses not covered
financial_eligibility: Comparative need evaluation by FA Committee; for students who cannot pay via instalments or Qarz-e-Hasna
documents_required: Online FA application (ibaapps.iba.edu.pk/financialassistance) with standard documents listed in the form
award_coverage: Tuition fee only (hostel/other charges not covered); percentage varies
deadline: Applications only during the window announced on the IBA FA webpage (date not found 2026-10-10)
renewal_notes: Award usually valid for the academic year (Fall+Spring); re-apply at the start of each academic year
notes: IBA FA also facilitates donor schemes (SEEF, HEC Ehsaas/BISP, CMEEF, BEEF) which need separate forms.

name: IBA National Talent Hunt Program (NTHP) Orientation - Admission Cycle 2027
eligible_locations: Pakistan; preference for rural Sindh, Punjab, Balochistan, KP, ex-FATA, GB, AJK
academic_eligibility: 80%+ in SSC-II (Matric) in 2025 from a Pakistani board; must not have taken any IBA aptitude test or applied in Fall 2026 or earlier cycles; no prior university/NGO orientation programme
documents_required: Stage 1 one-page pre-application; Stage 2 detailed form with documents (list in flyer)
award_coverage: Fully funded 3-week orientation/test preparation + one test-fee waiver; does NOT guarantee admission or NTHP degree scholarship
notes: Cycle-2027 windows passed. Next cycle (2028) not announced as of 2026-10-10.

notes: FAST also lists external sponsors: Sindh Govt Endowment (SEEF), PEEF, Punjab Honhaar, OSAF, FANA, Ihsan Trust, community scholarships.

award_coverage: Up to 90% of tuition fee; up to 3 instalments per semester also available
